# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser bus simulator arcade game titled Chrome Commute Sweatlord. Preserve top-down driving with gas, brake, left, right, friction, wall/vehicle collision damage, rider pickup scoring, heat escalation, health failure, game-over, and restart. Present the game as a satirical cyberpunk neon-noir bus route with chrome UI, retro leaderboard energy, one-thumb controls, readable mobile HUD, glowing rider beacons, inspector traffic, and a long chrome bus focal actor. Prompt basis: Bus Simulator. A satirical game inspired by Akira built around bus simulator play, with competitive, retro, leaderboard energy, commute friendly session design, search-friendly hooks like bus simulator, simulator, driving, aesthetics like chrome aesthetic, cyberpunk, neon noir, and meme-tone cues such as sweat lord, alpha male. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: top-down browser driving / bus simulator arcade loop
- objective: drive through a grid city, collect rider pickups for fare score, survive traffic and walls, and manage escalating heat.
- input model: keyboard arrows plus four touch buttons for left, right, gas, and brake.
- core loop: start route, accelerate/brake/steer a vehicle, camera follows the player, pickups respawn, traffic and pedestrians spawn around the player, collisions damage integrity, score and heat update, restart after failure.
- fail/friction state: integrity reaches zero after collision damage; route ends and final fare is shown.

## Protected mechanics
- Four-direction control semantics: left/right steer, gas accelerates, brake reverses/slows.
- Vehicle acceleration, friction, max speed, reversing limit, camera look-ahead, and requestAnimationFrame update loop.
- Grid city with roads, buildings/walls, open blocks, obstacle collision bounce/damage.
- Rider pickup contact adds 500 fare and respawns the pickup.
- NPC contact can add heat/penalty feedback while vehicle contact damages integrity.
- HUD score, heat, integrity, start, game over, and restart state flow.

## Remixed target
A portrait-first neon-noir bus simulator called Chrome Commute Sweatlord where the player pilots an exaggerated chrome commuter bus through a satirical cyberpunk transit grid. Riders are glowing fare beacons, traffic is ego traffic and fare inspectors, heat is lane shame, score is clout fare, and failure is the route being cooked. The rebuild changes presentation, HUD vocabulary, scene ownership, focal bus silhouette, and procedural visual motifs while preserving the driving loop.
